title: CULTURALFRAMES: Assessing Cultural Expectation Alignment in Text-to-Image Models and Evaluation Metrics

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation of text-to-image model outputs using culturally-grounded prompts across five socio-cultural domains to assess alignment with explicit and implicit cultural expectations, as well as the presence of cultural stereotypes.

Operationalizing cultural groups by country and having local annotators from 10 different countries evaluate generated images for regional authenticity, identifying country-specific inaccuracies and geographic generalizations.
